requiredFindings.title: The revocation quorum is not re-filtered by the set it establishes
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The embedded revocation is signed only by key K, and the list revokes K. Step 2 verifies it under the final root with an empty previously-revoked set, so K counts. Step 3 re-filters the chain, TR-CORE, and TR-BUNDLE, and those still meet threshold. The revocation quorum is never filtered by the resulting set, and the producer admits a release whose revoked set was established by a revoked key.

requiredFindings.title: The in-memory anchor store omits the record and the root-chain members capture loads
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The producer puts only the inventory pair, the bootstrap payload pair, and the index-0 root pair in the attempt store. core_anchor::capture loads the CoreAnchorNodeV1 record from the records collection and loads every later embedded root-chain member through EmbeddedCapture. Those bytes are absent, so the chain walk cannot complete.

scope: Law 463 r4 amendment: inventory locator, in-memory anchor, compiled-target platform id, TR-CORE and TR-BUNDLE quorums, revocation order, inventory home for K and flags, core-tree custody.
